role: Two previously exposed training boards only. No fresh ability estimate, win rate, promotion or exam.
prelaunch: Bind published protocol plus runtime code SHA. Require independent official verification of all 48 registered historical training roots, old/new support under common registered original orders, and >=1 actual positive same-step focal economic event contrast in target category on eligible 84/108/132/156 steps. Pass or hold each category separately; zero evidence means no start for that category. Shared-original physical single-call qualification and external-command interface self-check must pass. Store evidence hashes before prefix.
selection: At each assigned probe take full pre-request state. A is the actual unforced physical order from frozen 851c (including its one natural draw); A may differ from the proposal decoder top. Delete physically identical A from candidates. In the preregistered class consider stored catalog witnesses in native order (logit gap, slot, action tie-breaks). Keep first witness with a different complete physical team order and the required contrast relative to ACTUAL A at that same named focal worker. Deduplicate full orders, and save the complete native autoregressive prefix, legality, cash, geometry, A/B menu probabilities and actual native choice. Later units can re-decode. No scoring/scouting with true enemy command, hidden carbon, outcome, opponent private state or physical future. No alternate time points, maps, teams or rerolls. If none at all four probes, complete the one natural prefix to terminal and record no supported decision.
tree: Named focal own planter; exactly one of A and B stays on its current non-base cell, the other moves. A living own tree on that cell disqualifies it; eligible location is empty or occupied by an opposing tree, with enough currently visible cash to cover the current public rule price (plant or seize). New orders retain registered prefix legality and own conflict checks. Do not assume that apparent public affordability, root survival, or later budget availability guarantees a realized event. Report deliberate fixed enemy response at the root: trainable semantic event requires a paid purchase or seizure by that exact named planter in the stay arm and no such purchase by it in the moving arm.
freight: Named focal collector with current cargo > smeltCost. Exactly one of the two actual physical commands ends on any own base next step and the other ends off all own bases (toroidal coordinates). A safer move or generic homeward progress is insufficient. Require a positive verified own-base deposit by this exact worker only in the predicted depositing arm before using a deposit-response label. No replacement if interception, collision, or lack of opportunity prevents a valid label.
simultaneous: Both parties receive the same pre-action observations and starting bank. The original public agent naturally samples once at T=1 with its original 0.58s adaptive search and one physical root request ID shared by A and B. Save true post-call tracker/RNG/search state, native stats and time; restore this same post-state for each branch, never call it twice at this root. The real 851c draw is consumed once in each identical restored state; substituting the outgoing B command must leave its entire native hidden state and RNG equal to A. Only this current complete order is changed. All later commands are unconstrained genuine public outputs on each branch, until official terminal/extinction. A/B root share opponent time charge; later clocks use actual redeployed public requests.
evidence: Keep all tickets, errors and unsupported cases. Store signed prefix/arm orders, same underlying start position/ID sequence, both public views and original request IDs/CPU/wall/depth, cold clocks, returns, focal root economic events and cash categories. Independently replay official full board+ID+scores for both arms. For label eligibility require shared opponent request & poststate, exact distinct semantic commands, validated immediate focal event contrast, natural completion with healthy clock/valid requests and >=80% positive completed search depth among multi-candidate calls in prefix and each suffix separately (empty denominator indeterminate). No statistical claim from one stochastic terminal draw per arm; B minus A margin and U=0.5*(win+0.5*draw)+0.5*sigmoid(margin/1000) are conditional training returns.
runtime: CPU affinity 0 and 1 for both threads of the unchanged original. Sequential fixtures/arms; 299 transitions or official early stop. Preserve all resource/response errors. Local training diagnostic; no ladder certificate. No launching without team release.
